description: Implement settings module (Task 19.1): REST endpoints for user settings and privacy preferences. Settings include source-priority, theme, density, equalizer mode/intensity, dynamic palette, AAA contrast. Privacy settings stored in PrivacySetting model (key-value per user).
steps: Create apps/api/src/settings/settings.service.ts with methods: getSettings(userId) returns all privacy settings as key-value map, updateSettings(userId, settings: Record<string, string>) upserts PrivacySetting records, getPrivacy(userId) returns privacy-specific settings, updatePrivacy(userId, privacy: Record<string, string>) upserts privacy settings

Create apps/api/src/settings/settings.controller.ts with JWT-protected routes: GET /settings (returns all user settings), PATCH /settings (updates settings), GET /settings/privacy (returns privacy settings), PATCH /settings/privacy (updates privacy settings)
Run pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run lint, pnpm run build, pnpm run test
acceptance_criteria: GET /settings returns user settings as key-value map
findings: All verification passed: tests (132 pass), typecheck, lint, build all clean. Used same patterns as library module (controller with @Inject, JwtAuthGuard at class level, AuthenticatedRequest interface, direct service instantiation in tests with mock prisma).
